summary: In tests run on a small computer model rather than on people, Boceprevir received low risk scores of 37 for the liver and 27 for the heart [M]. The provided records list no specific side effects or warnings from the FDA for this drug [1][2]. Out of eight total clinical studies, one trial stopped recruiting because of market changes in hepatitis C treatments, while another was halted because a sharp drop in interferon use removed the need for the medicine [3][4][5]. A third trial was ended simply by the choice of the study's sponsor [3][6].
